body:
The required full-suite check for https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/pull/635 failed first attempt in `testRejectedDrainLoggingDoesNotHoldOutboxMonitor` at https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/actions/runs/40085745929/job/120848195951. This candidate continues [the downstream rollout handoff](https://www.handoff.wasmserver.com/handoffs/hf-2026-10-26-roll-the-merged-jvm-libp2p-duplicate-settlement-fix-downstream-publish-fork-pin-urlprotocol-publish-protocol-pin-urlresolver-flip-the-consumer-reproducer-and-finish-the-remote-runner-failure-reproducers): consume the published upstream close-future correction and verify the host-stop regression before the supervisor's reviewed release/pin chain.

**Do not merge: supervisor review is required, including the isolated original cleanup proposal at https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/commit/dd22e57d69bd26d39453d143b5f558fa52180ff4.** No merge, publication or deployment is requested by this update.

The upstream fix at https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/pull/71 preserves an already-completed channel-close result when listener notification is rejected by a full live event-loop queue. This branch selects published `1.3.0-codexcoder21-snapshot-41`, adds the deterministic real-host guard, retains the 128-cycle/eight-worker amplifier, and prepares protocol `0.0.1442`. Fresh published fork SHA-256 is `2482ff751bd14b929b3e6b9ad6161ce7a645eaff1c1bad7d43423a731edbfe3d` (1,890,830 bytes).

The amplifier's fixture now finishes both real request-handler entries in every cycle before any sibling holds or fills the shared NIO loop. Every injected task drains before ordinary cleanup, and all cleanup finishes before the next round. Failure terminates the shared Phaser; original assertions, eight callers, all 128 cycles and time limits remain. The separate original-test cleanup proposal remains isolated for supervisor assessment. A permanent framed-write guard verifies that a transport failure accepted between write and flush remains visible with its original cause; source already implements that behavior.

Validation on source `cc33cf0df81e5980d9cc80234a393192ecef392e` (rebased onto current main `1228066bfd53af6e7661f68e237710ab33176aa8` without changing the source head):

- Current-lane focused native-runner result: **4/4 first-attempt PASS**, zero failed attempt-history rows, on unchanged sourcecc33cf0df. Original rejected-drain, deterministic completed-close/full-loop, 128-cycle/eight-worker amplifier and accepted-write/flush guard all passed (native XML retained in the evidence branch).
- Prior controlled evidence: forced-one-loop old fixture failed 3/3; intermediate boundaries exposed further setup/cleanup defects; complete correction passed 10/10 direct component runs, retaining exact `completed=128 failed=0 concurrency=8 iterations=128`. Later native-runner register passed seven independent first attempts.
- Consumer selected-parent regression: unchanged resolver main red 3/3, producer snapshot-41 pin green 3/3 first attempt, retaining snapshot-32 in the test declaration. The final published protocol pin is still pending.
- Accepted-write/flush baseline on exact protocol1434 red 3/3; current source guard green. FreshJoin baseline red, source1442 comparison green 3/3, old baseline restored red. These are component proofs rather than full-suite results.
- **Full-suite gate for this candidate is GitHub-hosted `bld-build` and `bld-all-tests`, per supervisor direction at 2026-10-27 07:55Z.** Local complete-suite preparation was memory-killed; a subsequent bounded local run never reached test bodies. Remote BuildTest refused admission while recovering. No full local/remote pass or counts exist, and focused passes do not replace the hosted full gate. The existing workflows race local/remote; four test shards upload native XML with attempt histories.
- Historical NativeSha256 premain/readiness failure remains unresolved. A retry success is excluded from first-attempt evidence. Prior agent and JDK-only diagnostic controls both failed 2/32 under substantial page faults; this does not meet reliable reproduction or justify an agent patch. No test budget, heap, iteration count or assertion was relaxed.

Source/recovery and earlier red/green evidence: https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/fix/hq032-rollout-evidence/investigation/hq032 and https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/fix/hq054-runner-evidence/investigation/hq054 . Current-lane checkpoint: https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/tree/fix/hq064-rollout-evidence/investigation/hq064 .

Overlap retained for the supervisor: https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/pull/945 and https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/pull/962 have active snapshot-41 compatibility work; https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/pull/965 upgrades the full `bld-build` workflow. This candidate does not silently claim those changes. Final protocol publication must use reviewed combined main, include the bootstrap identity correction at https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/pull/960, and recheck metadata/pre-pins before choosing the release coordinate. Resolver publication/pin and final ExternalBrainWui readiness remain with the supervisor-directed rollout.
title: Do not merge: prepare host-stop regression and snapshot-41 pin
